description: Each command is valid in both POSIX sh and PowerShell. sh (macOS, Linux, WSL, containers, Windows with Git Bash) runs askright-hook.sh in its own process with `.` (no second shell to start, which costs about 1 s on Git Bash); PowerShell (Windows without Git Bash) runs askright-hook.ps1. Both print hookSpecificOutput JSON, so nothing shows in the terminal.
